name: Multiscale Structural Ensemble (MuSE)
description: Realistic physical systems are characterised by emergent interactions across multiple length and time scales, posing a significant challenge for predictive machine learning (ML) models. Most scientific ML models focus on a narrow range of interactions. While machine learning force fields (MLFFs) offer near-quantum accuracy, the ubiquitous message-passing layers miss long-range many-body effects.
